environment.description: ECS Fargate task running with default configuration. Container uses amazonlinux:2 base image with standard writable filesystem. Task definition has no readonlyRootFilesystem setting. Service is behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TCP passthrough on port 8765. No WAF or application-layer filtering. ALLOWED_ORIGINS set to 'https://dashboard.example.com' but Origin validation is bypassable.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener, no TLS termination
